package.basis: Desk only: Steam store/appdetails, 458 English Steam reviews via the review API, Steam news, the Trimps fandom wiki (Settings, Bone Trader) and prior repo research; not played.

fun.source: desk estimate: a deep, beloved text incremental (90.4% of 1,282 English reviews positive) but reviews stress "suuuper slow" arithmetic progress and a bare text presentation; below NGU (58) and well below Cookie Clicker 75.5 on feel/aesthetic, above Progress Quest 28.5 on decisions.

evidence.quote: Trimps is a text-based idle/incremental game
Graphics suck.
It is definitely not something we would play for the graphics.
Toggle on or off the building queue blue color animation.
The text-based presentation is functional but visually bare

dims.note: Coloured grid cells and a queue tint are the only motion.

evidence.quote: if the ui looks intimidating, trust me that everything is tutorialised super well and introduced gradually
looks very boring and confusing, but its actually easy to learn
Swap between Standard Formatting (12.7M, 540B), Engineering Notation ... Scientific Notation

dims.note: Dense but progressively revealed; many display settings.

evidence.quote: No review among 458 English reviews mentions music or sound (inference from a text game; not listened)
Brand new tutorial! After researching your first point of Science, ADVISOR will help guide you
the lack of a proper tutorial means new players must decipher the systems on their own
AutoFight from the Bloodlust drop at Z1 cell 10 (prior research: under 10 min)

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~50): AutoFight in minutes, but terse; reviewers disagree on the tutorial.

evidence.quote: the grind takes FOREVER
Game progress is suuuper slow.
Progression each loop is relatively minimal at first, but I promise there are plenty of surprises

dims.note: Surprises over months, but each portal is a small step and early automation is slow to arrive. No ending for a casual player.

evidence.quote: Over 50 different Challenges that tweak the Universe in different ways
the real strategic weight sits in how you allocate your population
others set up scripts to autoreset many times per day

dims.note: Challenges change the best build; heirlooms/perks/universes; an expert layer via fan scripts. Lapse: perk/challenge gains feel "10-20%" arithmetic to one reviewer.

evidence.quote: It's free, and it STAYS free, like not one of the "oh it's free but pay money to get ahead" games
a slight advantage to going offline … not enough that being actively online feels like a waste
'''Bone Trader''' is a premium shop ... Portal: Automatically gain Helium ... equal to ... your best run

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~80). Time Warp simulates offline (24 h full, resources beyond). Lapse: Bones are also sold, and the Bone Portal buys a whole run of Helium; bones also drop free in zones, and reviewers call it tipping.

evidence.quote: Instead of relying on flashy graphics or constant manual interaction, the game focuses on resource management
glad it made it to steam with more stable save system
I only closed it when it crashes randomly sometimes out of the blue
Patch 5.10.0 (2025-02-09) after ~7 years of updates

dims.note: Long-lived, saves port across web and Steam; occasional crash reports.

evidence.quote: Nearly 400 achievements ... Two different Universes to explore, mini games, a "pet" to level up
It's going to take years.
Universe 2: There is now a 1000 cell Mega-Spire at Z300

dims.note: Years of distinct systems; no ending.

evidence.quote: everything you love about your favorite games, distilled to their purest form
basically a living and evolving excel spread sheet

dims.note: Clear "text incremental with lots of automation" pitch; not distinctive from a screenshot.

evidence.quote: platforms: Windows only on Steam; supported_languages: 'English'; categories include Steam Cloud
I used to play Trimps in a browser at work ... I exported my game
Switches between the default Trimps theme, a custom dark theme ... a gradient theme

dims.note: Web plus Steam, save export, themes and notations; English only; no mobile app.

learn.practice: Tie automation unlocks to feats the player performs (AutoStorage from clearing a void map at Z20+), so automation feels earned and teaches the system it automates.
learn.evidence: https://trimps.fandom.com/wiki/NewPlayerGuide(Truth) (prior research: "AutoStorage when you clear a void map at Z20 or above")

learn.practice: Make offline slightly better than babysitting but never punishing, and say so: Time Warp simulates absence fully.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198157452747/recommended/1877960/ "a slight advantage to going offline … not enough that being actively online feels like a waste"

learn.practice: Use challenges that each twist one rule of the universe to make the best build change wall to wall (a model for stance/tactic restrictions per dungeon depth).
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=1877960 "Over 50 different Challenges that tweak the Universe in different ways"
